cases: manifest, PNG dimensions, root scope and active worker
real article and plugin-provided public layouts have one manifest and install entry
desktop/mobile light/dark entry, no horizontal overflow
offline new tab shows 503 fallback; login stays native; network recovery
config off unregisters worker, clears only owned caches and removes entry
plugin disable removes injected manifest and cleans installed worker
plugin uninstall cleans installed worker and preserves foreign cache
full browser restart while offline retains fallback; reconnect loads current page
limitations: Headless Chromium validates browser contracts; native OS installation and real iOS/Android devices are not exercised.
